# Test navigation icons supplied by an -icons directory.

md2html -html output -html-ext html -nav -icons icons site
exists output/index.html

# The icon a page named in its frontmatter is inlined into the sidebar.
grep 'data-icon="rocket"' output/quickstart.html
grep 'M12 15v5' output/quickstart.html

# A page that names no icon gets no marker.
! grep 'data-icon="plain"' output/quickstart.html

# A name the icon set does not carry leaves an empty marker rather than
# failing the build.
grep 'data-icon="no-such-icon" aria-hidden="true"></span>' output/quickstart.html

rm -rf output

# Without -icons, pages render from the built-in Font Awesome set.
md2html -html output -html-ext html -nav site
grep 'data-icon="rocket" aria-hidden="true"><svg' output/quickstart.html

rm -rf output

# -no-icons disables the built-in set without dropping the requested name.
md2html -html output -html-ext html -nav -no-icons site
grep 'data-icon="rocket" aria-hidden="true"></span>' output/quickstart.html

rm -rf output

# A directory holding no SVG files is a configuration error, not a
# silent build with every icon missing.
! md2html -html output -html-ext html -nav -icons empty site
stderr 'load icons'

-- site/index.md --
---
title: Home
---

# Home

-- site/quickstart.md --
---
title: Quickstart
icon: rocket
---

# Quickstart

-- site/plain.md --
---
title: Plain
---

# Plain

-- site/missing.md --
---
title: Missing
icon: no-such-icon
---

# Missing

-- icons/rocket.svg --
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" stroke="currentColor"><path d="M12 15v5"/></svg>

-- empty/readme.txt --
not an icon
